newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DHL adds second Lisbon frequency.
newsitem.headline: DHL adds second Lisbon frequency.

text.p: European Air Transport (EAT), the air transport arm of DHL International said it had introduced a second, nightly frequency on its Boeing 727F service to Lisbon from Brussels, effective end-June.
"This is a result of growing inbound traffic to Lisbon. Outbound traffic is also growing from the city but to a lesser extent" said Brussels-based EAT managing director, Gordon Olafson.
Brussels-Vitoria-Porto-Lisbon-Brussels while the established one reads: Brussels-Madrid-Lisbon-Brussels.
